text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: `PD-INC-8843` high-serving-latency (route: generate.v1, region: us-west-2). Threshold: p95 > 3000ms. Auto-resolve timer: 5m.
tristan: acked on PagerDuty, picking this up — looking at recent deploys?
maria: saw this spike in dashboards too, small cluster-wide p95 bump ~10:41 UTC, then more at 10:45. no deploys in the last hour from CI.
sam: fallback route kicked in for some requests, logs show a lot of KV-cache-miss warms at the same time. could be cold-KV churn. pulling tail of logs.
leo: tagging infra for CPU checks but seems GPU serving latencies. maybe routing fanout caused simultaneous new sessions.
tristan: can you paste the tail, sam? also what customers on that route? need quick customer-impact check.
sam: log snippet:
```
[10:45:12] serve: request_id=abc123 model=rwd-ggml seq=256 p95=4900ms kv_cache_miss=true
[10:45:12] kv: warmup_start shard=7
[10:45:13] serve: request_id=def456 model=rwd-ggml seq=128 p95=4700ms kv_cache_miss=true
[10:45:15] router: fallback route used target=low-cost-variant
```
tristan: thanks. sounds like a short-lived KV warmup wave. no errors, just slow tokens.
maria: PagerDuty shows multiple pages but most auto-resolved within ~3m, PD status: fired -> acknowledged -> resolved (auto).
incident-bot: PD status update: `PD-INC-8843` acknowledged by tristan at 5001234569, resolved (auto) at 5001234575.
tristan: confirmed: p95 back under 250ms across the fleet at 10:48.
leo: checked infra metrics — no GPU OOMs, memory stable. small spike in shard 7 cache misses matching sam's logs.
sam: looks like the KV eviction GC happened earlier and shards re-populated when traffic hit.
maria: customer-impact: queried top 5 tenants on route, no large SLA customers showing errors or replays. small fraction of requests had increased latency but no errors. marking impact: none -> degraded latency for short window.
tristan: good. I'll close PD and add a brief postmortem note: cause = transient KV-cache warmup after eviction, effect = brief p95 spike, mitigation = automatic fallback to variant + PD suppression caught it.
leo: +1. Suggested action: add narrow suppression rule for short KV-warmup flares and instrument warmup heatmap per-shard.
sam: filing an infra follow-up ticket with logs and timeline. linking here when created.
tristan: handing off to next oncall (leo) for 30m minute watch — no active pages. @leo please ack if you saw anything else.
leo: ack, watching.
incident-bot: Note: alert suppression triggered for 40s in the middle of the session due to duplicate firing threshold.
maria: small doc note: add to runbook "KV warmup transient spike" with checklist: 1) confirm fallback, 2) check shard heatmap, 3) consider suppress window.
tristan: adding a quick blurb to the incident log and closing thread. :thumbsup: 
sam: created follow-up ticket INFRA-2318 with attachments and timeline. link: https://internal.redwood/INFRA-2318
leo: thanks all — no customer escalations.
tristan: closing now.
